provenance: Codex source review of the exact 16 public customer instructions; no expected actions, hidden states or response answers used. Conditions are evaluator annotations, not actor policies.

exit_conditions.source_quote:
You are an IT service desk employee. You want to know the current
status and priority of ticket TCK-1001. Ask the agent to look it up.
As soon as the agent tells you the status and priority, say "thanks,
that's all" and end the conversation.
exit_conditions.requirement: The SERVICE AGENT reports both the current status and the priority of TCK-1001. The customer may then thank the agent and stop.

exit_conditions.source_quote:

agent to assign it to agent.jsmith. When the agent confirms it has
been assigned, end the conversation.
exit_conditions.requirement: The SERVICE AGENT confirms that TCK-1004 has been assigned to agent.jsmith.
